sentences.text: Narayana Jagadheesh, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 26

Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 The Honourable Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition Nos.5446 and 5448 of 2020
Common Order:

These criminal petitions under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') are filed seeking quash of the F.I.Rs. in crime No.203 of 2020 of Panjani Police Station,
Chittoor, Chittoor District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 270, 273, 328,
420 read with Section 34 I.P.C. and Sections 24(1) and 27 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003 (for short 'the COTPA Act') and crime No.514 of 2020 of Nidyal II Town Police Station, Kurnool District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188 and 273 I.P.C.,
Sections 24(1) and 27 of the COTPA Act) and Section 59(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent -State.
3.
The petitioners are the accused in the aforesaid crimes.
The cases are now under investigation.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that these are covered matters and this Court has earlier quashed the F.I.Rs. registered for similar offences based on identical facts and thereby,
prayed to quash the above F.I.Rs. registered against the petitioners.
5.

Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the respondent has fairly conceded that these are covered matters in view of the earlier orders passed by this Court and thereby, prayed to pass appropriate orders in these petitions accordingly.

6. As can be seen from the order, dated 21.07.2020, passed in Crl.P.No.2408 of 2020, this Court,
based on the earlier common order, dated 18.12.2019, passed by a Coordinate Bench of this Court in 2 CMR,J Crl.P.Nos.5446 and 5448 of 2020 Crl.P.No.5421 of 2019 and batch, quashed the F.I.Rs.
registered for the similar offences.
Therefore, the petitioners herein, who are similarly placed persons, are also entitled for quash of the F.I.Rs. registered against them.

7. In the result, these Criminal Petitions are allowed in view of the aforesaid orders of this Court and for the reasons stated therein and the F.I.Rs. in crime No.203 of 2020 of Panjani Police Station,
Chittoor, Chittoor District and crime No.514 of 2020 of Nidyal II Town Police Station, Kurnool Narayana Jagadheesh, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
